correctness.rationale: Definition 25 makes the generating element primitive in the ambient field \(\mathbb F_{p^{ln}}\). Its order \(p^{ln}-1\) forces a full \(ln\)-element \(p\)-Frobenius orbit, so any basis consisting of all conjugates has ambient dimension; conversely the primitive normal basis theorem supplies such a basis for the ambient field. In the exact \((4,3)\) witness, \(b=g^{34}\) and \(1+b=g^{31}\) lie in \(gH\), the distributivity equation is \(d^4=d\), and the checker confirms \(D(1,b)=\mathbb F_4\) with no element primitive in \(\mathbb F_{64}\).
